meta_description: Achala IT Solutions Private Limited — founded in 2009 in Hyderabad, an AI-first, platform-driven engineering company with global delivery from India, Germany and Bulgaria. 300+ projects, 95% client retention.

blocks.x: Achala IT Solutions Private Limited, founded in 2009, is a leading AI-first solutions and platform-driven company offering full-cycle software product engineering services. Headquartered in Hyderabad with global presence in Munich and Sofia, we empower Fortune 500 enterprises, SMEs and startups.

Achala was built on a simple conviction: industries transform when AI moves out of the lab and into production. That is why our teams own the whole arc — from proof-of-concept to industrialization — across generative AI, ML, data and analytics engineering, quality engineering, connected devices and IoT, design engineering, mobile application development and DevOps.

Today our platforms run in production where failure is not an option: the EEMS platform handles 50,000+ daily emergency cases across 9 states, our KYC systems verify customers in under 5 minutes, hospital BI deployments at KIMS Hospitals deliver 150+ dashboards, and our telematics work has optimized workforce efficiency by up to 40% for automotive clients.

We are recognized as Innovators in the NASSCOM #AI Game Changers 2021 program and were selected for the first cohort of the Telangana AI Mission (T-AIM) revv-up accelerator. In partnership with Sulzer GmbH — one of the 25 largest IT service providers in the German automotive industry — we operate Achala Sulzer Ltd. in Sofia, offering clients flexible and global shoring models.

Vision: empowering next-generation businesses to unlock the full potential of the digital landscape through our expertise in data, apps and analytics, supported by cutting-edge technologies like AI, ML, IoT, Cloud and Mobility in the Industry 4.0 era.
Mission: to revolutionize the digital landscape through innovative AI-driven solutions and platform-driven services, empowering businesses worldwide to thrive in the age of technology.
